halfLife.notes: Oral zuclopenthixol t½ ~20 hours. CYP2D6 substrate. Notably sedating compared to other FGAs. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.notes: No clinically significant active metabolites. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: CYP2D6 inhibitors may increase levels. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

metabolicRisk.notes: Moderate sedation and anticholinergic effects. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

lai.notes: LAI form = Clopixol Depot (zuclopenthixol decanoate). Also available as Clopixol Acuphase (zuclopenthixol acetate — short-acting IM for acute agitation).

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Gradual taper recommended when switching from depot to oral. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Oral tablets (Clopixol). LAI form = zuclopenthixol decanoate (Clopixol Depot) 200 mg/mL. Oral dose is approximately 8× the mg of decanoate dose per injection cycle. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
